methods.name: configure
methods.docs: Configure defaults used by future `show` calls.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.docs: Update determinate progress for a visible loader.

methods.name: setWebViewLayout
methods.docs: Apply a native WebView layout change without showing a loader.

methods.name: resetWebViewLayout
methods.docs: Restore the WebView layout captured before `setWebViewLayout` or `show`.

methods.name: getPluginVersion
methods.docs: Returns the platform implementation version marker.

interfaces.name: NativeLoaderConfigureOptions
interfaces.docs: Global defaults applied to future `show` calls.

properties.name: defaults
properties.docs: Default show options.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Stable loader id. A generated id is returned when omitted.

properties.name: style
properties.docs: Built-in style or asset renderer. Defaults to `siri`.

properties.name: placement
properties.docs: Native window placement. Defaults to `center`.

properties.name: frame
properties.docs: Custom frame used when `placement` is `custom`.

properties.name: message
properties.docs: Optional loading message shown below or near the loader.

properties.name: size
properties.docs: Loader size in points / CSS pixels. Defaults to `96`.

properties.name: thickness
properties.docs: Thickness for ring, edge, and progress loaders. Defaults to `5`.

properties.name: duration
properties.docs: Animation duration in milliseconds for one cycle. Defaults vary by style.

properties.name: speed
properties.docs: Animation speed multiplier. Defaults to `1`.

properties.name: progress
properties.docs: Determinate progress from `0` to `1`. Omit for indeterminate loaders.

properties.name: colors
properties.docs: Loader colors. Built-in loaders use the first colors as gradient stops.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.docs: Container background color.

properties.name: scrimColor
properties.docs: Fullscreen scrim color. Used by `fullscreen` and `around` placements when set.

properties.name: cornerRadius
properties.docs: Corner radius for the floating container. Defaults to `24`.

properties.name: blurRadius
properties.docs: Native blur radius where supported. Defaults to `0`.

properties.name: autoHide
properties.docs: Hide automatically after this many milliseconds.

properties.name: interactionMode
properties.docs: Touch handling for the overlay. Defaults to `passThrough` unless `scrimColor` is set.

properties.name: reducedMotion
properties.docs: Reduced motion behavior. Defaults to `system`.

properties.name: accessibilityLabel
properties.docs: Accessibility label announced when the loader appears.

properties.name: asset
properties.docs: Asset configuration for `lottie` and `image` loaders.

properties.name: webView
properties.docs: Optional native WebView layout mutation while the loader is visible.

interfaces.name: NativeLoaderFrame
interfaces.docs: Absolute frame in CSS pixels / device-independent points.

properties.name: x
properties.docs: Left offset.

properties.name: y
properties.docs: Top offset.

properties.name: width
properties.docs: Frame width.

properties.name: height
properties.docs: Frame height.

interfaces.name: NativeLoaderAsset
interfaces.docs: Native file, bundled asset, remote URL, or data URL used by `lottie` and `image` loaders.

properties.name: source
properties.docs:
Asset path or URL.

Supported forms:
- app bundle asset name, for example `loader.json`
- `file://` URL
- `https://` or `http://` URL
- `data:application/json;base64,...` for Lottie JSON
- `data:image/...;base64,...` for images

properties.name: type
properties.docs: Explicit asset type. Defaults to the current loader `style`.

properties.name: loop
properties.docs:
Repeat asset animation. Defaults to `true`.

Lottie assets loop their composition. Image assets loop their native rotation.

properties.name: speed
properties.docs:
Asset animation speed multiplier. Defaults to `1`.

Applies to Lottie playback speed and image rotation speed.

properties.name: autoPlay
properties.docs:
Start asset animation immediately. Defaults to `true`.

For image assets, this starts the native rotation loader.

properties.name: mode
properties.docs:
Layout mode.

`resize` changes the native WebView frame/margins. `inset` changes scroll
content inset/padding where the platform supports it. `none` leaves the
WebView untouched.

properties.name: insets
properties.docs: Insets applied in `resize` or `inset` mode.

properties.name: frame
properties.docs:
Replace the WebView frame instead of using insets. Used only by iOS and
by Android parents that support absolute layout params.

properties.name: restoreOnHide
properties.docs: Restore the previous WebView layout when the loader is hidden. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: animated
properties.docs: Animate the layout change where the platform supports it. Defaults to `true`.

interfaces.name: NativeLoaderInsets
interfaces.docs: Insets in CSS pixels / device-independent points.

properties.name: top
properties.docs: Top inset.

properties.name: right
properties.docs: Right inset.

properties.name: bottom
properties.docs: Bottom inset.

properties.name: left
properties.docs: Left inset.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Loader id that can be passed to `update`, `setProgress`, or `hide`.

interfaces.name: NativeLoaderUpdateOptions
interfaces.docs: Update an existing loader. Any omitted property keeps its current value.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Loader id to update.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Loader id. When omitted, the top-most/current loader receives progress.

properties.name: progress
properties.docs: Determinate progress from `0` to `1`.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Loader id. When omitted, the top-most/current loader is hidden.

properties.name: animated
properties.docs: Animate dismissal. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: restoreWebView
properties.docs: Restore WebView layout immediately. Defaults to `true`.

properties.name: showing
properties.docs: Whether at least one loader is visible.

properties.name: ids
properties.docs: Visible loader ids from oldest to newest.

properties.name: version
properties.docs: Version identifier returned by the platform implementation.

typeAliases.name: NativeLoaderStyle
typeAliases.docs:
Built-in native loader renderer.

- `siri`: blurred, rotating multi-orb loader inspired by assistant listening UI.
- `siri-v2`: full-screen Siri-style color motion around the screen edge.
- `chrome`: full-width top edge progress bar inspired by browser page loading UI.
- `orbit`: dots orbiting a transparent center.
- `ring`: rotating stroked ring.
- `pulse`: expanding translucent ripples.
- `dots`: three bouncing dots.
- `bars`: equalizer-style vertical bars.
- `wave`: flowing horizontal wave.
- `halo`: glowing radial halo.
- `lottie`: native Lottie JSON animation from `asset`.
- `image`: native image view from `asset`, rotating when `autoPlay` is enabled.

typeAliases.name: NativeLoaderPlacement
typeAliases.docs: Where the loader is anchored in the native window.

typeAliases.name: NativeLoaderInteractionMode
typeAliases.docs: How the native overlay handles pointer/touch input while the loader is visible.

typeAliases.name: NativeLoaderReducedMotionMode
typeAliases.docs: How platform reduced-motion settings affect animated loaders.

typeAliases.name: NativeLoaderWebViewMode
typeAliases.docs: How to alter the Capacitor WebView while a loader is visible.
